mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC block with a high multi-scale rescaled-range slope has converted volatility into persistent displacement across several horizons. When the full block and final two hours agree in direction, that persistent price-discovery path should continue for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of completed eight-hour and final-two-hour returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVRSH estimates a scaling exponent from mean rescaled ranges at fixed 30, 60, and 120 minute segment lengths. Serial-autocorrelation uses one return lag; variance-ratio compares fixed aggregated variance; sign entropy and sign runs discard magnitudes; ordinal complexity ranks completed hourly closes. HVRSH uses no flow, volume, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the causal realized-variation rank explicitly restricts activation to elevated volatility, while the scaling tail separates persistent paths from high-volatility churn
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC scaling-state onsets with an eight-hour reservation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.returns: 479 close-to-close log returns inside the completed block
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute returns), strict positive
features.rescaled_range: for each non-overlapping segment, range of cumulative demeaned returns divided by sample standard deviation; every segment must have finite positive standard deviation
features.hurst_slope: OLS slope of log(mean segment rescaled range) on log(segment length) at fixed lengths 30, 60, and 120 returns; no fitted intercept or threshold is reused across blocks
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.hurst_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 valid blocks, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.75
features.block_return: log(last close/first open) over eight hours
features.late_return: log(last close/open at D-2h) over final two hours
features.direction_confirmation: block and late returns have one strict nonzero sign
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, or control repair.
